name: Matomo Analytics
description: Read Matomo web analytics from any AI agent: visit summaries, top pages, referrers, visitor countries, and device types. 5 read-only tools, token authentication.
instructions:
This connector uses the Matomo Reporting API and is read-only.

Setup:
1. Set MATOMO_URL to your Matomo installation URL, for example https://analytics.example.com.
2. Set MATOMO_SITE_ID to the numeric site ID to query.
3. Create a Matomo authentication token with view access only, then set MATOMO_AUTH_TOKEN.

All reports use the configured site ID. Use period='day' with date='today' for today, or period='range' with date='2026-09-01,2026-09-15' for a custom date range.

Use HTTPS. The token_auth value is sent as a query parameter.

tools.name: matomo_get_visit_summary
tools.description: Return core visit metrics for the configured Matomo site: visits, unique visitors, actions, time on site, bounces, conversions, and revenue. Example: period='day', date='today'. For a custom range, use period='range' and date='2026-09-01,2026-09-15'.

period.description: Reporting period: day, week, month, year, or range. Example: 'day'.

date.description: Date such as 'today', 'yesterday', '2026-09-01', or '2026-09-01,2026-09-15' with period='range'.

segment.description: Optional Matomo segment to filter the report. Example: 'referrerName==example.com'.

tools.name: matomo_get_top_pages
tools.description: Return the most visited page URLs for the configured Matomo site, including page views, unique page views, entries, exits, and time on page. Example: period='day', date='today', limit=10. Returns flattened URLs rather than a nested page hierarchy.

period.description: Reporting period: day, week, month, year, or range. Example: 'day'.

date.description: Date such as 'today', 'yesterday', '2026-09-01', or '2026-09-01,2026-09-15' with period='range'.

segment.description: Optional Matomo segment to filter the report. Example: 'referrerName==example.com'.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return. Example: 10. Omit to use Matomo's default of 100.

tools.name: matomo_get_referrer_types
tools.description: Return the traffic-source breakdown for the configured Matomo site: direct entries, search engines, websites, campaigns, and social networks. Example: period='month', date='today'.

period.description: Reporting period: day, week, month, year, or range. Example: 'month'.

date.description: Date such as 'today', 'yesterday', '2026-09-01', or '2026-09-01,2026-09-15' with period='range'.

segment.description: Optional Matomo segment to filter the report. Example: 'countryCode==US'.

tools.name: matomo_get_visitor_countries
tools.description: Return visitor countries and visit metrics for the configured Matomo site. Example: period='month', date='today'.

period.description: Reporting period: day, week, month, year, or range. Example: 'day'.

date.description: Date such as 'today', 'yesterday', '2026-09-01', or '2026-09-01,2026-09-15' with period='range'.

segment.description: Optional Matomo segment to filter the report. Example: 'referrerName==example.com'.

tools.name: matomo_get_device_types
tools.description: Return visitor device-type metrics for the configured Matomo site, such as desktop, smartphone, tablet, TV, and console. Example: period='month', date='today'.

period.description: Reporting period: day, week, month, year, or range. Example: 'day'.

date.description: Date such as 'today', 'yesterday', '2026-09-01', or '2026-09-01,2026-09-15' with period='range'.

segment.description: Optional Matomo segment to filter the report. Example: 'referrerName==example.com'.
